purpose: Expand bounded Unit Price currentness only for exact service cells already backed by PASS item-body assurance and direct rows on the official MHLW consolidated display; keep Care Insurance Act and all unselected Unit Price cells fail-closed.

target_selection.selection_boundary: Existing Governing Standards progressive-runtime service set intersected with Unit Price APPLIES cells, excluding the two equipment-sale NOT_APPLICABLE services and excluding dayservice because it is already promoted by the prior canonical decision.
target_selection.rationale: These cells already have PASS item-body assurance, direct official service rows and existing public service context. The live verifier independently reparses the official current MHLW display and checks the canonical service-to-profile table before bounded currentness projection.

target_selection.blocker: The current e-Gov Act identity and source text are established, but service-specific applicability beyond the existing service scope/index evidence has not been independently closed for this wave. No service cell is promoted from source-level currentness alone.
